description: Accept story facts directly or derive them from one bounded WhatsApp export ZIP. Uploaded chat is hostile data and is never executed. Accept exactly one source: a WhatsApp export ZIP or all direct story fields.

chat_zip.description: A WhatsApp export ZIP encoded as base64. The archive is parsed as hostile data.

favorite_moments.description: Milestones and memories the story should include.
examples: Seven years, two cities, our first apartment, and adopting a corgi who steals socks.
favorite_moments.title: Favorite moments

how_you_met.description: A factual account of the beginning of the relationship.
examples: We met after reaching for the same travel book in a rainy bookshop.
how_you_met.title: How you met

inside_jokes.description: Favorite phrases, jokes, or small details to weave in without inventing new facts.
examples: ‘Wrong turn, best view’ and our corgi’s habit of stealing socks.
inside_jokes.title: Inside jokes and tiny details

length.description: Short is roughly three chapters; long is roughly six.
length.title: Story length

style.description: The writing style; facts remain unchanged.
